description: S5 confirmation pass — 5-min steps at the max sustainable rate found by s5-explore (and the next rate where the explore knee differed from the baseline), full criteria (30 s warm-up). 12 partitions, 1 KB, default maxInFlight 1000. f1/f10/s1 share the baseline knee (65k, in-flight bound) and are represented by their heaviest sibling (f50, s5); the baseline itself is S2 p12 (65k confirmed).
